title: this is wild to me
content: I recently discovered this sub and it’s so cool to me that so many people go to a similar place whilst dreaming . I’ve been having these dreams for the past decade or so. I always thought it was just because I used to work in a huge mall years ago. which I suppose that may be why, but still, it’s interesting that the majority of my dreams today still take place in this giant mall world. mine are usually sort of like an entire indoor city, with everything a mall has, plus apartments, houses, schools, etc. it is impossibly vast, almost infinite. if I go outside, sometimes there’s a beach on the ocean, other times it’s a huge, foggy parking lot. usually, it seems the mall world is like a society protected from the outside world for whatever reason. most of it is very clean and bright, lots of stuff to do, bustling with people and it’s usually a good energy. sometimes I get lost in an apartment area that seems very old, rotting and falling apart. other times, I’m at what seems to be a house inside the mall, that has hallways where every door is a bathroom. the bathrooms themselves are shaped like seemingly endless hallways, with lots of toilets, showers, and sinks. usually very clean and cutely decorated, but endless. many of my dreams tend to be mundane, but sometimes exciting things or drama happens. I just find it very interesting lol! many times these dreams are incredibly vivid, and feel like they last multiple days or even weeks. when I wake up I almost feel exhausted, like I just got back from a long trip.
